H-AX-L1.name: Meadow

sphere_commentary.overview:
The three series deliver broadly positive outcomes (means 6.5‑7.2) with distinct confidence patterns.
• HEALING holds the largest sample (n=574) and the tightest variance, indicating stable entrainment.
• THRIVING shows comparable means but higher spread in some HOLD protocols, hinting at subgroup effects.
• TRANSFORMING carries the lowest mean and highest std, consistent with its ascending‑arc design and diverse listener states.
• Several protocols (e.g., X‑MC‑L3, X‑MD‑L1) exhibit marked divergences between observed and AutoGluon predictions, flagging them for deeper review.
sphere_commentary.cross_series:
Efficacy aligns with design intent but cross‑series overlaps appear.
• HEALING DESCENT protocols (e.g., H‑AX‑L1, H‑OS‑L1) consistently achieve >7.0 means, reflecting strong regulation.
• THRIVING HOLD protocols rise toward the top of the overall distribution, with T‑FC‑L3 reaching 7.63, suggesting focus benefits from prolonged hold.
• TRANSFORMING ASCENT protocols generally lag (mean≈6.5), yet X‑ME‑L2 and X‑MD‑L3 break the pattern, indicating possible niche success.
sphere_commentary.anomalies:
Four protocol clusters stand out as statistical or qualitative mismatches.
• X‑MC‑L3 (mean 5.70, std 2.45) is an outlier with adverse listener reports, diverging sharply from its AutoGluon prediction (7.54).
• H‑AX‑L1 shows a bimodal score distribution despite high positive sentiment, suggesting distinct listener subpopulations.
• X‑MD‑L1 and X‑MD‑L2 report low positive percentages (45%/43%) and modest means, contrary to ASCENT design expectations.
• T‑MB‑L3 has a notable non‑settle rate (4/19) and a wide std, indicating possible routing or entrainment issues.
sphere_commentary.development_signals:
Targeted refinements emerge from convergent signals.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] X‑MC‑L3 – redesign Hz parameters or retire, given severe under‑performance and adverse feedback.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] H‑AX‑L1 – investigate subgroup split; consider stratified routing or variable descent length to resolve bimodality.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] X‑MD‑L1 & X‑MD‑L2 – increase motivational arc intensity or adjust tempo to raise positive response rates.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] T‑MB‑L3 – add a brief hold phase or simplify rhythm to reduce non‑settle occurrences.
• [CONVERGENT SIGNAL] H‑CR‑L3 – extend descent phase by ~15 s to improve rapid‑settle complaints and music liking scores.
sphere_commentary.embedding_analysis:
Embedding signals suggest evolving analytic landscapes.
• CROSS‑RUN DRIFT: 33 protocols show similarity < 0.85; X‑MD‑L3 (0.507) and H‑SL‑L1 (0.530) exhibit the strongest drift, warning of potential feature instability.
• CROSS‑PROTOCOL CLUSTERS: Strong pairings include T‑FC‑L1↔L2 (0.878), H‑SL‑L1↔L2 (0.869), T‑CF‑L1↔L2 (0.841); isolated protocols (e.g., H‑OS‑L3) may need distinct modeling.
• Confidence: embedding drift metrics are limited by sparse YouTube retention data; interpret with caution.

by_protocol_plain.H-AX-L1: Meadow helps anxious listeners settle in about ten minutes, with most finding it calming and effective.
by_protocol_plain.H-AX-L2: Cottage offers solid anxiety relief, though some people need a longer listen to feel the benefit.
by_protocol_plain.H-AX-L3: Valley gives noticeable calm for most, but a few listeners feel it doesn’t change anything.
by_protocol_plain.H-CR-L1: Anchor provides modest crisis support; a few users feel a big lift quickly, others need more time.
by_protocol_plain.H-CR-L2: Harbor gives a gentle calming effect in distress, though results vary across listeners.
by_protocol_plain.H-CR-L3: Horizon works fast for some, but several listeners aren’t happy with the music or the effect.
by_protocol_plain.H-OS-L1: Pebble is a strong over‑stimulation balancer that many listeners love and find quickly soothing.
by_protocol_plain.H-OS-L2: Rainfall eases overstimulation well, with most people feeling better after about ten minutes.
by_protocol_plain.H-OS-L3: Glacier helps most people settle, though a few need a bit longer to notice the calm.
by_protocol_plain.H-SL-L1: Lantern supports sleep nicely, with most feeling the benefit within five to ten minutes.
by_protocol_plain.H-SL-L2: Hammock is good for sleep, especially when a caregiver is listening for someone else.
by_protocol_plain.H-SL-L3: Midnight works for many sleepers, offering calm after a short listen.
by_protocol_plain.T-CF-L1: Ember sparks a bit of creative flow, though improvements are often mild.
by_protocol_plain.T-CF-L2: Current builds on that, giving a steadier creative boost for most listeners.
by_protocol_plain.T-CF-L3: Aurora delivers the strongest creative lift, especially for those listening to support others.
by_protocol_plain.T-FC-L1: Compass helps focus a little, but the rhythm can feel busy for some users.
by_protocol_plain.T-FC-L2: Waypoint improves focus more noticeably, with many users liking the music.
by_protocol_plain.T-FC-L3: Summit offers the best focus boost, with most listeners reporting big improvements.
by_protocol_plain.T-MB-L1: Stone keeps balance well, though some listeners need a longer session to feel it.
by_protocol_plain.T-MB-L2: Axis shows mixed results; some people feel it right away, others don’t settle.
by_protocol_plain.T-MB-L3: Orbit improves balance for many, but a few listeners never feel it settle.
by_protocol_plain.X-MC-L1: Cavern offers gentle mental clarity; see X‑MC‑L1 description.
by_protocol_plain.X-MC-L2: Starlight offers calming mental clarity; see X‑MC‑L2 description.
by_protocol_plain.X-MC-L3: Cosmos underperforms and can feel worse for some; see X‑MC‑L3 description.
by_protocol_plain.X-MD-L1: Footpath tries to boost motivation but many listeners feel it’s too busy or ineffective.
by_protocol_plain.X-MD-L2: Trail has similar motivation issues, with only a few users feeling a lift.
by_protocol_plain.X-MD-L3: Switchback shows promise for motivation, though responses are split between strong and weak effects.
by_protocol_plain.X-ME-L1: Breeze lifts mood modestly, but listeners often need a long settle time.
by_protocol_plain.X-ME-L2: Sunrise gives a slightly better mood boost, with some users feeling a notable lift.
by_protocol_plain.X-ME-L3: Updraft provides the smallest mood improvement, and several listeners report no change.
